name: REA Super-agent Morris lake pilot

base.approach: Pinned upstream fork, actual DSH execution validation, local Source and execution adapters; preserve native recovery records internally.

objective: Continuously improve Morris lake through scene observations and reusable capability learning.
components: capability graph and recipes in REACodeRefactoring
Morris read-only probes and reversible preview adapter
pilotExperiments: Hollow-voxel wind repair as engineering canary
Shared World + wind + existing vegetation/decor response, if local spatial wind sampling needs new adapter implement and verify
One bounded lakeside composition combining paths/planting/building footprints without changing protected scene identities

milestones.name: Runtime grounding
milestones.doneWhen: Pinned DSH fork launches a real worker, handles async result and restart recovery; local events reach correct worker.

milestones.name: Scene perception
milestones.doneWhen: Morris probes report actual versions, occupancy, routes, fixed camera captures and performance baseline.

milestones.name: Closed learning loop
milestones.doneWhen: A selected capability improves a real preview, fails/retries honestly, promotes with evidence and can roll back.

milestones.name: Capability composition
milestones.doneWhen: A bounded lakeside recipe combines capabilities, preserves traversal and visual identity, is reusable on another seed.

milestones.name: Sustained operation
milestones.doneWhen: Duplicate events, stale evidence, worker stall, provider failure and machine offline recovery are exercised.

limits: No model-weight training implied by learning.
GPU and local-device tasks wait while device is offline.
No upstream benchmark speedup or token savings assumed.
Do not expose unrestricted shell endpoints through pipeline UI.

confirmedArchitecture.protection: Immutable snapshots; candidate must never silently replace manual work or finals
confirmedArchitecture.firstSlice: Scene registry, real editor entry, snapshots, compare, restore, codec validation, explicit final archive and exact-ID runtime loading
